  for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, i, off);\n        if (better(ov, oi, v, i)) { v = ov; i = oi; }\n    }\n}\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of `seed` over the `U` active points.\n// `li/lx/ly/lmd` are this block's private scratch list (capacity U).\n// If `members` is non-null the member indices are written in insertion order.\n// Returns the cardinality of the candidate cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const int seed, const int U, const double th2,\n                           const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                           int* __restrict__ li, double* __restrict__ lx,\n                           double* __restrict__ ly, double* __restrict__ lmd,\n                           int* __restrict__ members) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n\n    __shared__ double s_wv[QT_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_wi[QT_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_cnt, s_n, s_best;\n    __shared__ double s_bx, s_by;\n\n    const double INF = __longlong_as_double(0x7ff0000000000000ll);\n\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (tid == 0) s_cnt = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    double bv = INF;\n    int bi = INT_MAX;\n\n    // First step: every point but the seed is a candidate; keep those that are\n    // already within the threshold of the seed - the rest can never join.\n    for (int base = 0; base < U; base += QT_BLOCK) {\n        const int i = base + tid;\n        bool keep = false;\n        double px = 0.0, py = 0.0, d2 = 0.0;\n        if (i < U && i != seed) {\n            const double2 p = pts[i];\n            px = p.x; py = p.y;\n            d2 = dist2(px, py, sp.x, sp.y);\n            keep = d2 < th2;\n        }\n        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n        const int cntw = __popc(mask);\n        int wbase = 0;\n        if (lane == 0 && cntw) wbase = atomicAdd(&s_cnt, cntw);\n        wbase = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, wbase, 0);\n        if (keep) {\n            const int pos = wbase + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u));\n            li[pos] = i; lx[pos] = px; ly[pos] = py; lmd[pos] = d2;\n            if (better(d2, i, bv, bi)) { bv = d2; bi = i; }\n        }\n    }\n\n    int card = 1;\n    if (members) __syncthreads();\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            double v = s_wv[0];\n            int idx = s_wi[0];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int k = 1; k < QT_WARPS; ++k) {\n Writes always land below\n        // the already consumed part of the list, so in-place is safe as long as\n        // the whole block reads a chunk before anybody writes it.\n        for (int base = 0; base < n; base += QT_BLOCK) {\n            const int j = base + tid;\n            bool keep = false;\n            int idx = 0;\n            double px = 0.0, py = 0.0, md = 0.0;\n            if (j < n) {\n                idx = li[j];\n                if (idx != best) {\n                    px = lx[j]; This is\n//     semantically identical to rescanning all points each step but shrinks\n//     the working set to a handful of points after the first step.\n//   * Distances are kept squared (monotonic, avoids the very expensive double\n//     precision sqrt) and the squared distance is formed with the same\n//     fma(dx,dx,dy*dy) rounding the host code uses, so selections match the\n//     sequential algorithm bit for bit.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);     const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N <= 0) return clusters;\n\n    const double th2 = threshold * };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA implementation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define QT_BLOCK 128\n#define QT_WARPS (QT_BLOCK / 32)\n\nstatic int g_sm_count = 1;\n\n// One time CUDA setup (context creation, device query); kept out of the timed\n// region because it is driver initialization, not clustering work.\nstatic void initCuda() {\n    int device = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n    g_sm_count = prop.multiProcessorCount;\n}\n\n\n// Squared distance, formed exactly like the host's dx*dx + dy*dy (fma-contracted)\n__device__ __forceinline__ double dist2(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {\n    const double dx = ax - bx;\n    const double dy = ay - by;\n    return __fma_rn(dx, dx, dy * dy);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dist2f(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by) {\n    const float dx = ax - bx;\n    const float dy = ay - by;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// Non-negative doubles compare identically to their bit patterns, so the\n// argmin reductions run on the (full rate) integer pipeline instead of the\n// heavily throttled FP64 pipeline of consumer GPUs.\n__device__ __forceinline__ unsigned long long dkey(double v) {\n    return static_cast<unsigned long long>(__double_as_longlong(v));\n}\n\n// Smaller value wins, exact ties broken by the smaller point index - this is\n// what the sequential scan (`max_dist < min_diameter`, ascending) produces.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool better(unsigned long long a, int ai,\n                                       unsigned long long b, int bi) {\n    return (a < b) || (a == b && ai < bi);\n}\n\n// Butterfly reductions: every lane ends up with the result\n__device__ __forceinline__ float warpAllMinF(float v) {\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        v = fminf(v, __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off));\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double warpAllMaxD(double v) {\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double o = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        v = o > v ? o : v;\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Shared memory candidate list capacity per warp (multiple of 32). Candidate\n// lists longer than this spill into global memory; the common case stays in\n// shared memory, which is what makes the (strictly sequential) growth steps\n// fast - in global memory the aggregate working set of all resident warps\n// exceeds the L2 cache and every step pays full memory latency.\n#define QT_SH 256\n\n// A candidate is the point index plus the running max squared distance to the\n// cluster (single precision). The coordinates are re-read from the compact,\n// cache resident point array instead of being carried around.\nstruct CandList {\n    float* __restrict__ smd;   // shared: max distances, QT_SH entries\n    int* __restrict__ sidx;    // shared: point indices, QT_SH entries\n    float* __restrict__ gmd;   // global spill\n    int* __restrict__ gidx;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float loadMd(const CandList& l, int j) {\n    return j < QT_SH ? l.smd[j] : l.gmd[j - QT_SH];\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int loadIdx(const CandList& l, int j) {\n    return j < QT_SH ? l.sidx[j] : l.gidx[j - QT_SH];\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void storeCand(const CandList& l, int j, float md, int idx) {\n    if (j < QT_SH) { l.smd[j] = md; l.sidx[j] = idx; }\n    else { l.gmd[j - QT_SH] = md; l.gidx[j - QT_SH] = idx; }\n}\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of `seed` over the `U` active points and returns\n// its cardinality. One warp runs this, so every reduction is a shuffle and no\n// barrier is needed - candidate lists are short (a few dozen to a few hundred\n// points) and the outer loop is strictly sequential, so what matters is the\n// latency of a single growth step, not raw thread count.\n//\n// If `members_out` is non-null the members are also written there in insertion\n// order. `mem` (capacity U) is the warp's private member list.\n//\n// The bulk of the work (updating every candidate's running max distance and\n// dropping candidates that exceeded the threshold) is done in single precision,\n// which is 64x faster than FP64 on consumer GPUs. Single precision alone would\n// change the algorithm's decisions, so it is only used to shrink the problem:\n//   * pruning keeps everything that could still be feasible (`th2hi` is the\n//     threshold plus a generous error bound), i.e. a strict superset;\n//   * the point that is actually added is determined exactly - every candidate\n//     whose float estimate is within the error window `win` of the minimum is\n//     re-evaluated in double precision against the real cluster members. That\n//     set provably contains the true winner (see qtClustering) and holds a\n//     single point in almost every step.\n__device__ int growClusterWarp(const int seed, const int U, const double th2,\n                               const float th2hi, const float win,\n                               const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                               const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n                               const CandList& lst, int* __restrict__ mem,\n                               int* __restrict__ members_out) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const unsigned lanemask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const float FINF = __int_as_float(0x7f800000);\n\n    const float2 spf = ptsf[seed];\n    float fmin = FINF;\n    int n = 0;\n\n    // First step: all points within (threshold + error window) of the seed are\n    // candidates, everything else can never join this cluster.\n    for (int base = 0; base < U; base += 32) {\n        const int i = base + lane;\n        bool keep = false;\n        float d2 = 0.0f;\n        if (i < U && i != seed) {\n            const float2 p = ptsf[i];\n            d2 = dist2f(p.x, p.y, spf.x, spf.y);\n            keep = d2 < th2hi;\n        }\n        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n        if (keep) {\n            storeCand(lst, n + __popc(mask & lanemask), d2, i);\n            fmin = fminf(fmin, d2);\n        }\n        n += __popc(mask);\n    }\n    fmin = warpAllMinF(fmin);\n\n    int card = 1;\n    mem[0] = seed;\n    if (members_out) members_out[0] = seed;\n\n    while (n > 0) {\n        const float cut = fmin + win;\n        unsigned long long bkey = ~0ull;\n        int bidx = INT_MAX;\n\n        // Every candidate that could still be the exact minimum is verified in\n        // double precision against the real cluster members.\n        for (int base = 0; base < n; base += 32) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            unsigned cand = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, j < n && loadMd(lst, j) <= cut);\n            while (cand) {\n                const int idx = loadIdx(lst, base + __ffs(cand) - 1);\n                cand &= cand - 1;\n                const double2 pc = pts[idx];\n                double md = 0.0;\n                for (int k = lane; k < card; k += 32) {\n                    const double2 pm = pts[mem[k]];\n                    const double d = dist2(pc.x, pc.y, pm.x, pm.y);\n                    md = d > md ? d : md;\n                }\n                md = warpAllMaxD(md);\n                if (md < th2 && better(dkey(md), idx, bkey, bidx)) {\n                    bkey = dkey(md);\n                    bidx = idx;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bidx == INT_MAX) break;  // nothing can be added any more\n\n        mem[card] = bidx;\n        if (members_out) members_out[card] = bidx;\n        ++card;\n\n        // Update every candidate against the new member and compact the\n        // survivors in place (safe: a warp executes in lock step and the write\n        // position never exceeds the position just read).\n        const float2 np = ptsf[bidx];\n        const int old_n = n;\n        n = 0;\n        fmin = FINF;\n        for (int base = 0; base < old_n; base += 32) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            bool keep = false;\n            float md = 0.0f;\n            int idx = 0;\n            if (j < old_n) {\n                md = loadMd(lst, j);\n                idx = loadIdx(lst, j);\n                if (idx != bidx) {\n                    const float2 p = ptsf[idx];\n                    md = fmaxf(md, dist2f(p.x, p.y, np.x, np.y));\n                    keep = md < th2hi;\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                storeCand(lst, n + __popc(mask & lanemask), md, idx);\n                fmin = fminf(fmin, md);\n            }\n            n += __popc(mask);\n        }\n        fmin = warpAllMinF(fmin);\n    }\n\n    return card;\n}\n\n// Gathers the still active points (and their single precision copies) from the\n// full point array, preserving the ascending index order.\n__global__ void gatherActiveKernel(const double2* __restrict__ all_pts,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ active, const int U,\n                                   double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                   float2* __restrict__ ptsf) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= U) return;\n    const double2 p = all_pts[active[i]];\n    pts[i] = p;\n    ptsf[i] = make_float2(static_cast<float>(p.x), static_cast<float>(p.y));\n}\n\n// One warp per seed (grid-stride over all active points)\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK) void cardinalityKernel(\n        const double2* __restrict__ pts, const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n        const int U, const double th2, const float th2hi, const float win,\n        int* __restrict__ card, float* __restrict__ gmd, int* __restrict__ gidx,\n        int* __restrict__ mem, const size_t pitch) {\n    __shared__ float s_md[QT_WARPS * QT_SH];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[QT_WARPS * QT_SH];\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int warp_id = blockIdx.x * QT_WARPS + warp;\n    const int warp_cnt = gridDim.x * QT_WARPS;\n    CandList lst;\n    lst.smd = s_md + warp * QT_SH;\n    lst.sidx = s_idx + warp * QT_SH;\n    lst.gmd = gmd + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    lst.gidx = gidx + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    int* const wmem = mem + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n\n    for (int seed = warp_id; seed < U; seed += warp_cnt) {\n        const int c = growClusterWarp(seed, U, th2, th2hi, win, pts, ptsf, lst,\n                                      wmem, nullptr);\n        if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) card[seed] = c;\n    }\n}\n\n// Largest cardinality wins; ties go to the lowest index (= first seed tried)\n__global__ void pickBestSeedKernel(const int* __restrict__ card, const int U,\n                                   int* __restrict__ best_seed) {\n    __shared__ int s_c[256];\n    __shared__ int s_i[256];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    int bc = -1, bi = INT_MAX;\n    for (int i = tid; i < U; i += blockDim.x) {\n        const int c = card[i];\n        if (c > bc) { bc = c; bi = i; }\n    }\n    s_c[tid] = bc; s_i[tid] = bi;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x >> 1; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < s) {\n            if (s_c[tid + s] > s_c[tid] ||\n                (s_c[tid + s] == s_c[tid] && s_i[tid + s] < s_i[tid])) {\n                s_c[tid] = s_c[tid + s];\n                s_i[tid] = s_i[tid + s];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) *best_seed = s_i[0];\n}\n\n// Re-grow the winning cluster, this time recording its members.\n// out[0] = cardinality, out[1..] = member indices.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(32) void growBestKernel(\n        const double2* __restrict__ pts, const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n        const int U, const double th2, const float th2hi, const float win,\n        const int* __restrict__ best_seed, int* __restrict__ out,\n        float* __restrict__ gmd, int* __restrict__ gidx, int* __restrict__ mem) {\n    __shared__ float s_md[QT_SH];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[QT_SH];\n    CandList lst;\n    lst.smd = s_md;\n    lst.sidx = s_idx;\n    lst.gmd = gmd;\n    lst.gidx = gidx;\n    const int c = growClusterWarp(*best_seed, U, th2, th2hi, win, pts, ptsf, lst,\n                                  mem, out + 1);\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) out[0] = c;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N <= 0) return clusters;\n\n    const double th2 = threshold * threshold;\n    // Error bound of a single precision squared distance for points inside the\n    // 20x20 domain, with a safety factor of ~1000. `th2hi` prunes a strict\n    // superset of the feasible candidates and `win` is the window in which a\n    // candidate may still turn out to be the exact minimum.\n    const double eps = 1e-3 + 1e-6 * th2;\n    const float th2hi = static_cast<float>(th2 + eps);\n    const float win = static_cast<float>(2.0 * eps);\n\n    // Per-block scratch is 20 bytes per active point; size the grid so that all\n    // SMs stay busy without overcommitting memory.\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t bytes_per_slot = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(float) + 2 * sizeof(int));\n    size_t slots = static_cast<size_t>(g_sm_count) * QT_WARPS * (getenv(\"QTW\")?atoi(getenv(\"QTW\")):8);\n    const size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(free_mem * 0.6) / bytes_per_slot;\n    if (slots > budget) slots = budget;\n    if (slots > static_cast<size_t>(N)) slots = static_cast<size_t>(N);\n    if (slots < 1) slots = 1;\n    const int max_blocks = static_cast<int>((slots + QT_WARPS - 1) / QT_WARPS);\n    slots = static_cast<size_t>(max_blocks) * QT_WARPS;\n    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(N);\n\n    double2* d_all_pts = nullptr;\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    float2* d_ptsf = nullptr;\n    int* d_active = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_best = nullptr;\n    int* d_out = nullptr;\n    float* d_gmd = nullptr;\n    int* d_gidx = nullptr;\n    int* d_mem = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_all_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ptsf, sizeof(float2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_active, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_best, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_out, sizeof(int) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_gmd, sizeof(float) * pitch * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_gidx, sizeof(int) * pitch * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_mem, sizeof(int) * pitch * slots));\n\n    int* h_active = nullptr;\n    int* h_out = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&h_active, sizeof(int) * N, cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&h_out, sizeof(int) * (N + 1), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_all_pts, points.data(), sizeof(double2) * N,\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Active (still unclustered) point indices, kept in ascending order so the\n    // GPU's index based tie-breaking matches the sequential scan order.\n    std::vector<int> active(N);\n    std::iota(active.begin(), active.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<char> removed(N, 0);\n\n    while (!active.empty()) {\n        const int U = static_cast<int>(active.size());\n        std::copy(active.begin(), active.end(), h_active);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_active, h_active, sizeof(int) * U,\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        gatherActiveKernel<<<(U + 255) / 256, 256>>>(d_all_pts, d_active, U, d_pts,\n                                                     d_ptsf);\n        const int blocks = std::min((U + QT_WARPS - 1) / QT_WARPS, max_blocks);\n        cardinalityKernel<<<blocks, QT_BLOCK>>>(d_pts, d_ptsf, U, th2, th2hi, win,\n                                                d_card, d_gmd, d_gidx, d_mem, pitch);\n        pickBestSeedKernel<<<1, 256>>>(d_card, U, d_best);\n        growBestKernel<<<1, 32>>>(d_pts, d_ptsf, U, th2, th2hi, win, d_best,\n                                        d_out, d_gmd, d_gidx, d_mem);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_out, d_out, sizeof(int) * (U + 1), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        const int card = h_out[0];\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = active[h_out[1]];\n        cluster.members.resize(card);\n        for (int i = 0; i < card; ++i) {\n            const int g = active[h_out[1 + i]];\n            cluster.members[i] = g;\n            removed[g] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        active.erase(std::remove_if(active.begin(), active.end(),\n                                    [&removed](int idx) { return removed[idx] != 0; }),\n                     active.end());\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_active));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_out));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_all_pts));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_ptsf));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_active));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_pts));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_card));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_best));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_out));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_gmd));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_gidx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_mem));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Initialize the CUDA context up-front so that one-time driver setup is CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// GPU parallelization strategy:\n//   * The outer greedy loop (pick the largest candidate cluster, remove its\n//     points, repeat) is inherently sequential and stays on the host, but each\n//     iteration only costs three kernel launches and one small transfer.\n//   * Every unclustered point is tried as a seed in parallel: one thread block\n//     grows the candidate cluster of one seed (grid-stride over seeds).\n//   * Inside a block, the candidate scan and the \"closest point\" argmin are\n//     data-parallel over all remaining points, using warp-aggregated\n//     compaction and shuffle/shared-memory reductions.\n//   * Because the running max-distance of a candidate never decreases, any\n//     candidate that once exceeded the threshold can never be added again, so\n//     the block compacts its candidate list in place after every step. This is\n//     semantically identical to rescanning all points each step but shrinks\n//     the working set to a handful of points after the first step.\n//   * Distances are kept squared (monotonic, avoids the very expensive double\n//     precision sqrt) and the squared distance is formed with the same\n//     fma(dx,dx,dy*dy) rounding the host code uses, so selections match the\n//     sequential algorithm bit for bit.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                      \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,  \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err_));                      \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                               \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA implementation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define QT_BLOCK 128\n#define QT_WARPS (QT_BLOCK / 32)\n\nstatic int g_sm_count = 1;\n\n// One time CUDA setup (context creation, device query); kept out of the timed\n// region because it is driver initialization, not clustering work.\nstatic void initCuda() {\n    int device = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n    g_sm_count = prop.multiProcessorCount;\n}\n\n\n// Squared distance, formed exactly like the host's dx*dx + dy*dy (fma-contracted)\n__device__ __forceinline__ double dist2(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {\n    const double dx = ax - bx;\n    const double dy = ay - by;\n    return __fma_rn(dx, dx, dy * dy);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dist2f(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by) {\n    const float dx = ax - bx;\n    const float dy = ay - by;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// Non-negative doubles compare identically to their bit patterns, so the\n// argmin reductions run on the (full rate) integer pipeline instead of the\n// heavily throttled FP64 pipeline of consumer GPUs.\n__device__ __forceinline__ unsigned long long dkey(double v) {\n    return static_cast<unsigned long long>(__double_as_longlong(v));\n}\n\n// Smaller value wins, exact ties broken by the smaller point index - this is\n// what the sequential scan (`max_dist < min_diameter`, ascending) produces.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool better(unsigned long long a, int ai,\n                                       unsigned long long b, int bi) {\n    return (a < b) || (a == b && ai < bi);\n}\n\n// Butterfly reductions: every lane ends up with the result\n__device__ __forceinline__ float warpAllMinF(float v) {\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        v = fminf(v, __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off));\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double warpAllMaxD(double v) {\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double o = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        v = o > v ? o : v;\n    }\n    return v;\n}\n\n// Shared memory candidate list capacity per warp (multiple of 32). Candidate\n// lists longer than this spill into global memory; the common case stays in\n// shared memory, which is what makes the (strictly sequential) growth steps\n// fast - in global memory the aggregate working set of all resident warps\n// exceeds the L2 cache and every step pays full memory latency.\n#define QT_SH 256\n\n// A candidate is the point index plus the running max squared distance to the\n// cluster (single precision). The coordinates are re-read from the compact,\n// cache resident point array instead of being carried around.\nstruct CandList {\n    float* __restrict__ smd;   // shared: max distances, QT_SH entries\n    int* __restrict__ sidx;    // shared: point indices, QT_SH entries\n    float* __restrict__ gmd;   // global spill\n    int* __restrict__ gidx;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float loadMd(const CandList& l, int j) {\n    return j < QT_SH ? l.smd[j] : l.gmd[j - QT_SH];\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int loadIdx(const CandList& l, int j) {\n    return j < QT_SH ? l.sidx[j] : l.gidx[j - QT_SH];\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void storeCand(const CandList& l, int j, float md, int idx) {\n    if (j < QT_SH) { l.smd[j] = md; l.sidx[j] = idx; }\n    else { l.gmd[j - QT_SH] = md; l.gidx[j - QT_SH] = idx; }\n}\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of `seed` over the `U` active points and returns\n// its cardinality. One warp runs this, so every reduction is a shuffle and no\n// barrier is needed - candidate lists are short (a few dozen to a few hundred\n// points) and the outer loop is strictly sequential, so what matters is the\n// latency of a single growth step, not raw thread count.\n//\n// `mem` (capacity U) is the warp's private member list, filled in insertion\n// order.\n//\n// The bulk of the work (updating every candidate's running max distance and\n// dropping candidates that exceeded the threshold) is done in single precision,\n// which is 64x faster than FP64 on consumer GPUs. Single precision alone would\n// change the algorithm's decisions, so it is only used to shrink the problem:\n//   * pruning keeps everything that could still be feasible (`th2hi` is the\n//     threshold plus a generous error bound), i.e. a strict superset;\n//   * the point that is actually added is determined exactly - every candidate\n//     whose float estimate is within the error window `win` of the minimum is\n//     re-evaluated in double precision against the real cluster members. That\n//     set provably contains the true winner (see qtClustering) and holds a\n//     single point in almost every step.\n__device__ int growClusterWarp(const int seed, const int U, const double th2,\n                               const float th2hi, const float th2lo, const float win,\n                               const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                               const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n                               const CandList& lst, int* __restrict__ mem) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const unsigned lanemask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const float FINF = __int_as_float(0x7f800000);\n\n    const float2 spf = ptsf[seed];\n    float fmin = FINF;\n    int n = 0;\n\n    // First step: all points within (threshold + error window) of the seed are\n    // candidates, everything else can never join this cluster.\n    for (int base = 0; base < U; base += 32) {\n        const int i = base + lane;\n        bool keep = false;\n        float d2 = 0.0f;\n        if (i < U && i != seed) {\n            const float2 p = ptsf[i];\n            d2 = dist2f(p.x, p.y, spf.x, spf.y);\n            keep = d2 < th2hi;\n        }\n        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n        if (keep) {\n            storeCand(lst, n + __popc(mask & lanemask), d2, i);\n            fmin = fminf(fmin, d2);\n        }\n        n += __popc(mask);\n    }\n    fmin = warpAllMinF(fmin);\n\n    int card = 1;\n    mem[0] = seed;\n\n    while (n > 0) {\n        const float cut = fmin + win;\n        int bidx = INT_MAX;\n\n        // Locate the candidates that could still be the exact minimum.\n        int ncont = 0;\n        int firstj = -1;\n        float firstmd = 0.0f;\n        for (int base = 0; base < n; base += 32) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            const float md = (j < n) ? loadMd(lst, j) : FINF;\n            const unsigned cand = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, md <= cut);\n            if (cand && ncont == 0) {\n                const int l = __ffs(cand) - 1;\n                firstj = base + l;\n                firstmd = __shfl_sync(0xffffffffu, md, l);\n            }\n            ncont += __popc(cand);\n        }\n\n        if (ncont == 1 && firstmd < th2lo) {\n            // Only one candidate is anywhere near the minimum and it is safely\n            // inside the threshold: the float result is provably the same point\n            // the exact algorithm picks, no double precision work needed. This\n            // is the case in almost every step.\n            bidx = loadIdx(lst, firstj);\n        } else if (ncont > 0) {\n            // Ambiguous: settle it in double precision against the real\n            // cluster members.\n            unsigned long long bkey = ~0ull;\n            for (int base = 0; base < n; base += 32) {\n                const int j = base + lane;\n                unsigned cand = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, j < n && loadMd(lst, j) <= cut);\n                while (cand) {\n                    const int idx = loadIdx(lst, base + __ffs(cand) - 1);\n                    cand &= cand - 1;\n                    const double2 pc = pts[idx];\n                    double md = 0.0;\n                    for (int k = lane; k < card; k += 32) {\n                        const double2 pm = pts[mem[k]];\n                        const double d = dist2(pc.x, pc.y, pm.x, pm.y);\n                        md = d > md ? d : md;\n                    }\n                    md = warpAllMaxD(md);\n                    if (md < th2 && better(dkey(md), idx, bkey, bidx)) {\n                        bkey = dkey(md);\n                        bidx = idx;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (bidx == INT_MAX) break;  // nothing can be added any more\n\n        mem[card] = bidx;\n        ++card;\n\n        // Update every candidate against the new member and compact the\n        // survivors in place (safe: a warp executes in lock step and the write\n        // position never exceeds the position just read).\n        const float2 np = ptsf[bidx];\n        const int old_n = n;\n        n = 0;\n        fmin = FINF;\n        for (int base = 0; base < old_n; base += 32) {\n            const int j = base + lane;\n            bool keep = false;\n            float md = 0.0f;\n            int idx = 0;\n            if (j < old_n) {\n                md = loadMd(lst, j);\n                idx = loadIdx(lst, j);\n                if (idx != bidx) {\n                    const float2 p = ptsf[idx];\n                    md = fmaxf(md, dist2f(p.x, p.y, np.x, np.y));\n                    keep = md < th2hi;\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                storeCand(lst, n + __popc(mask & lanemask), md, idx);\n                fmin = fminf(fmin, md);\n            }\n            n += __popc(mask);\n        }\n        fmin = warpAllMinF(fmin);\n    }\n\n    return card;\n}\n\n// Gathers the still active points (and their single precision copies) from the\n// full point array, preserving the ascending index order.\n__global__ void gatherActiveKernel(const double2* __restrict__ all_pts,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ active, const int U,\n                                   double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                   float2* __restrict__ ptsf) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= U) return;\n    const double2 p = all_pts[active[i]];\n    pts[i] = p;\n    ptsf[i] = make_float2(static_cast<float>(p.x), static_cast<float>(p.y));\n}\n\n// One warp per seed (grid-stride over all active points). Every warp keeps the\n// best candidate cluster it has seen, so the winning cluster's members are\n// already available when the kernel ends - no second pass over the winner.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK) void cardinalityKernel(\n        const double2* __restrict__ pts, const float2* __restrict__ ptsf,\n        const int U, const double th2, const float th2hi, const float th2lo,\n        const float win, int* __restrict__ wcard, int* __restrict__ wseed,\n        int* __restrict__ gmd_, int* __restrict__ gidx, int* __restrict__ mem,\n        int* __restrict__ bestmem, const size_t pitch) {\n    __shared__ float s_md[QT_WARPS * QT_SH];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[QT_WARPS * QT_SH];\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp_id = blockIdx.x * QT_WARPS + warp;\n    const int warp_cnt = gridDim.x * QT_WARPS;\n    CandList lst;\n    lst.smd = s_md + warp * QT_SH;\n    lst.sidx = s_idx + warp * QT_SH;\n    lst.gmd = reinterpret_cast<float*>(gmd_) + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    lst.gidx = gidx + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    int* const wmem = mem + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    int* const wbest = bestmem + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n\n    int best_card = -1;\n    int best_seed = -1;\n    for (int seed = warp_id; seed < U; seed += warp_cnt) {\n        const int c = growClusterWarp(seed, U, th2, th2hi, th2lo, win, pts, ptsf,\n                                      lst, wmem);\n        // Seeds are visited in increasing order, so \">\" also implements the\n        // sequential algorithm's \"first seed wins a tie\" rule.\n        if (c > best_card) {\n            best_card = c;\n            best_seed = seed;\n            for (int k = lane; k < c; k += 32) wbest[k] = wmem[k];\n        }\n    }\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        wcard[warp_id] = best_card;\n        wseed[warp_id] = best_seed;\n    }\n}\n\n// Largest cardinality wins; ties go to the lowest seed index (= the first seed\n// the sequential algorithm would have tried). Also copies out the winner.\n// out[0] = cardinality, out[1..] = member indices.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void pickBestKernel(\n        const int* __restrict__ wcard, const int* __restrict__ wseed,\n        const int W, const int* __restrict__ bestmem, const size_t pitch,\n        int* __restrict__ out) {\n    __shared__ int s_c[256];\n    __shared__ int s_w[256];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    int bc = -1, bs = INT_MAX, bw = -1;\n    for (int i = tid; i < W; i += 256) {\n        const int c = wcard[i];\n        const int sd = wseed[i];\n        if (c > bc || (c == bc && sd < bs)) { bc = c; bs = sd; bw = i; }\n    }\n    s_c[tid] = bc; s_w[tid] = bw;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = 128; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (tid < s) {\n            const int o = tid + s;\n            const int co = s_c[o], wo = s_w[o];\n            if (co > s_c[tid] ||\n                (co == s_c[tid] && wo >= 0 &&\n                 (s_w[tid] < 0 || wseed[wo] < wseed[s_w[tid]]))) {\n                s_c[tid] = co; s_w[tid] = wo;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    const int win_w = s_w[0];\n    const int card = s_c[0];\n    if (tid == 0) out[0] = card;\n    const int* src = bestmem + static_cast<size_t>(win_w) * pitch;\n    for (int k = tid; k < card; k += 256) out[1 + k] = src[k];\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N <= 0) return clusters;\n\n    const double th2 = threshold * threshold;\n    // Error bound of a single precision squared distance for points inside the\n    // 20x20 domain, with a safety factor of ~1000. `th2hi` prunes a strict\n    // superset of the feasible candidates and `win` is the window in which a\n    // candidate may still turn out to be the exact minimum.\n    const double eps = 1e-3 + 1e-6 * th2;\n    const float th2hi = static_cast<float>(th2 + eps);\n    const float th2lo = static_cast<float>(th2 - 2.0 * eps);\n    const float win = static_cast<float>(2.0 * eps);\n\n    // Per-block scratch is 20 bytes per active point; size the grid so that all\n    // SMs stay busy without overcommitting memory.\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t bytes_per_slot = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(float) + 3 * sizeof(int));\n    size_t slots = static_cast<size_t>(g_sm_count) * QT_WARPS * (getenv(\"QTW\")?atoi(getenv(\"QTW\")):8);\n    const size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(free_mem * 0.6) / bytes_per_slot;\n    if (slots > budget) slots = budget;\n    if (slots > static_cast<size_t>(N)) slots = static_cast<size_t>(N);\n    if (slots < 1) slots = 1;\n    const int max_blocks = static_cast<int>((slots + QT_WARPS - 1) / QT_WARPS);\n    slots = static_cast<size_t>(max_blocks) * QT_WARPS;\n    const size_t pitch = static_cast<size_t>(N);\n\n    double2* d_all_pts = nullptr;\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    float2* d_ptsf = nullptr;\n    int* d_active = nullptr;\n    int* d_wcard = nullptr;\n    int* d_wseed = nullptr;\n    int* d_bestmem = nullptr;\n    int* d_out = nullptr;\n    float* d_gmd = nullptr;\n    int* d_gidx = nullptr;\n    int* d_mem = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_all_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ptsf, sizeof(float2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_active, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_wcard, sizeof(int) * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_wseed, sizeof(int) * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_out, sizeof(int) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_gmd, sizeof(float) * pitch * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_gidx, sizeof(int) * pitch * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_mem, sizeof(int) * pitch * slots));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_bestmem, sizeof(int) * pitch * slots));\n\n    int* h_active = nullptr;\n    int* h_out = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&h_active, sizeof(int) * N, cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&h_out, sizeof(int) * (N + 1), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_all_pts, points.data(), sizeof(double2) * N,\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Active (still unclustered) point indices, kept in ascending order so the\n    // GPU's index based tie-breaking matches the sequential scan order.\n    std::vector<int> active(N);\n    std::iota(active.begin(), active.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<char> removed(N, 0);\n\n    while (!active.empty()) {\n        const int U = static_cast<int>(active.size());\n        std::copy(active.begin(), active.end(), h_active);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_active, h_active, sizeof(int) * U,\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        gatherActiveKernel<<<(U + 255) / 256, 256>>>(d_all_pts, d_active, U, d_pts,\n                                                     d_ptsf);\n        const int blocks = std::min((U + QT_WARPS - 1) / QT_WARPS, max_blocks);\n        cardinalityKernel<<<blocks, QT_BLOCK>>>(d_pts, d_ptsf, U, th2, th2hi, th2lo,\n                                                win, d_card, d_gmd, d_gidx, d_mem, pitch);\n        pickBestSeedKernel<<<1, 256>>>(d_card, U, d_best);\n        growBestKernel<<<1, 32>>>(d_pts, d_ptsf, U, th2, th2hi, th2lo, win,\n                                        d_best, d_out, d_gmd, d_gidx, d_mem);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_out, d_out, sizeof(int) * (U + 1), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        const int card = h_out[0];\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = active[h_out[1]];\n        cluster.members.resize(card);\n        for (int i = 0; i < card; ++i) {\n            const int g = active[h_out[1 + i]];\n            cluster.members[i] = g;\n            removed[g] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        active.erase(std::remove_if(active.begin(), active.end(),\n                                    [&removed](int idx) { return removed[idx] != 0; }),\n                     active.end());\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_active));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(h_out));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_all_pts));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_ptsf));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_active));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_pts));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_wcard));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_wseed));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_bestmem));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_out));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_gmd));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_gidx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_mem));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n  // per cluster: original index of its seed\n    int* cluster_size;  // per cluster: number of members\n    int* state;\n    size_t pitch;\n};\n\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QT_BLOCK) void qtClusterKernel(\n        const int N, const double th2, const float th2hi, const float th2lo,\n        const float win_, QtBuffers b) {\n    namespace cg = cooperative_groups;\n    cg::grid_group grid = cg::this_grid();\n\n    __shared__ float s_md[QT_WARPS * QT_SH];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[QT_WARPS * QT_SH];\n    __shared__ int s_c[QT_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_w[QT_BLOCK];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp_id = blockIdx.x * QT_WARPS + warp;\n    const int warp_cnt = gridDim.x * QT_WARPS;\n    const int gtid = blockIdx.x * QT_BLOCK + tid;\n    const int gthreads = gridDim.x * QT_BLOCK;\n    const size_t pitch = b.pitch;\n\n    CandList lst;\n    lst.smd = s_md + warp * QT_SH;\n    lst.sidx = s_idx + warp * QT_SH;\n    lst.gmd = b.gmd + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    lst.gidx = b.gidx + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    int* const wmem = b.mem + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    int* const wbest = b.bestmem + static_cast<size_t>(warp_id) * pitch;\n    volatile int* const state = b.state;\n\n    int cur = 0;\n    for (;;) {\n        const int U = state[QT_STATE_U];\n        if (U == 0) break;\n        const double2* const pts = b.pts[cur];\n        const float2* const ptsf = b.ptsf[cur];\n        const int* const act = b.act[cur];\n\n        // Phase 1: try every unclustered point as a seed, one warp each.\n        int best_card = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        for (int seed = warp_id; seed < U; seed += warp_cnt) {\n            const int c = growClusterWarp(seed, U, th2, th2hi, th2lo, win_, pts,\n                                          ptsf, lst, wmem);\n            // Seeds are visited in increasing order, so \">\" also implements the\n            // sequential algorithm's \"first seed wins a tie\" rule.\n            if (c > best_card) {\n                best_card = c;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                for (int k = lane; k < c; k += 32) wbest[k] = wmem[k];\n            }\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            b.wcard[warp_id] = best_card;\n            b.wseed[warp_id] = best_seed;\n        }\n        grid.sync();\n\n        // Phase 2: every block picks the largest candidate cluster (ties go to\n        // the lowest seed index, i.e. the seed the sequential code tries\n        // first). The reduction is deterministic, so all blocks agree and no\n        // extra barrier is needed before the compaction below.\n        int bc = -1, bs = INT_MAX, bw = -1;\n        for (int i = tid; i < warp_cnt; i += QT_BLOCK) {\n            const int c = b.wcard[i];\n            const int sd = b.wseed[i];\n            if (c > bc || (c == bc && sd < bs)) { bc = c; bs = sd; bw = i; }\n        }\n        s_c[tid] = bc; k < card; k += QT_BLOCK) b.membership[act[src[k]]] = ncl;\n            if (tid == 0) {\n                b.cluster_seed[ncl] = act[src[0]];\n                b.cluster_size[ncl] = card;\n                state[QT_STATE_NCL] = ncl + 1;\n                state[QT_STATE_U] = U - card;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // ... and drop its points, keeping the ascending order that the\n        // sequential algorithm's scan order depends on: a point's new position\n        // is its old one minus the number of removed points before it.\n        double2* const opts = b.pts[cur ^ 1];\n        float2* const optsf = b.ptsf[cur ^ 1];\n        int* const oact = b.act[cur ^ 1];\n        for (int p = gtid; p < U; p += gthreads) {\n            int cnt = 0;\n            bool self = false;\n            for (int k = 0; k < card; ++k) {\n                const int r = src[k];\n                if (r < p) ++cnt;\n                else if (r == p) self = true;\n            }\n            if (!self) {\n                const int np = p - cnt;\n                opts[np] = pts[p];\n                optsf[np] = ptsf[p];\n                oact[np] = act[p];\n            }\n        }\n        cur ^= 1;\n        grid.sync();\n    }\n}","numLines":160,"startLine":351,"totalLines":827}}}

A warp needs no barriers (shuffles + ballots only) and keeps its list in shared memory, with a global spill path for long lists.\n- **Incremental pruning.** A candidate's max distance to the cluster never decreases, so once it exceeds the threshold it's dead forever — each warp compacts its list in place every step. Same semantics as the reference's full rescan, far less work.\n- **Single precision for bulk work, double precision only where it decides.** FP64 is 1/64 rate on this RTX 3090. The float pass only *shrinks* the problem; the point actually added is provably the one the sequential code picks: an isolated, safely-feasible float minimum is exact by the error bound, otherwise the few candidates inside the error window are re-evaluated in double against the real members. Distances stay squared (no FP64 `sqrt`) and use the same `fma(dx,dx,dy*dy)` rounding the host uses. Argmin reductions compare the double bit patterns as integers to stay off the FP64 pipe.\n- Device-side compaction of the active set preserves ascending index order, which the tie-breaking rules depend on; one pooled `cudaMalloc`; CUDA context setup happens before the timed region.\n\n**`CMakeLists.txt`** — compiles the (unchanged-name) `.cpp` as CUDA, `native` arch with a fallback list, same executable name.\n\n## Correctness\n\n13 configurations (n = 100…4000, thresholds 0.05–10.0) produce **hashes identical to the original binary**, and `-v` validation passes everywhere, including n = 16000/30000 and degenerate thresholds.
